description: This file is a shell script designed for testing the 'git hash-object' command. It includes setup and teardown functions for a temporary repository, various test cases to verify the behavior of hashing objects within Git, handling of stdin and file arguments, error conditions, and attribute filtering related to object hashing.

methods.name: echo_without_newline
methods.description: Prints arguments without appending a newline, using printf '%s' format.

methods.name: setup_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository and creates sample files for hashing.

methods.name: push_repo
methods.description: Creates and enters a new git repository for testing.

methods.name: pop_repo
methods.description: Cleans up by returning to previous directory and removing the test repository.

methods.name: test_blob_does_not_exist
methods.description: Verifies that a blob with a given hash does not exist in the repository.

methods.name: test_blob_exists
methods.description: Verifies that a blob with a given hash exists in the repository.
